issue_paraphrase: A static-site build with the default security settings is supposed to refuse fetching web resources from localhost and from private or special-purpose IP networks. Two families of addresses slip through the default checks: a URL whose scheme is written in mixed case, such as an all-caps HTTP scheme pointing at a loopback address, is allowed because the deny rules only match lowercase schemes; and several non-public ranges (shared/CGNAT space, TEST-NET, benchmarking and reserved ranges, IPv6 documentation prefixes, and NAT64 mappings that embed a private IPv4 address) are treated as ordinary public Internet addresses. A page that fetches such a URL therefore succeeds instead of being blocked.
fix_summary: Made the default IP-literal deny rule case-insensitive with (?i) and replaced the IsGlobalUnicast/IsPrivate gate in CheckAllowedHTTPAddress with an isPublicAddr helper that unwraps NAT64 prefixes and denies CGNAT, TEST-NET, benchmarking, reserved, IETF-assignment and documentation prefixes explicitly.
notes: Era: master/HEAD (Sep 2026, hugo dev 0.167.x), tree builds with Go 1.27.1 from go.dev (the module-based Go fork; same toolchain all of current hugo CI uses). No extended/CGO build tag needed for these tests, no network at test time beyond the first dependency download. Same-era package: config/security is tiny, so this is the cheapest candidate to rebuild. Running the -run filter is important: without it the same package run also fails TestToTOML at the parent (it asserts the exact default-rule TOML text, which legitimately changes).

issue_paraphrase: When a content page consists only of front matter with no body, pages that print the raw content of the page output the file's front matter text itself instead of an empty body. The template sees the whole file, delimiters and YAML keys included, so a simple layout that wraps the raw content in visible markers shows '---' and the front-matter keys in the rendered HTML. Pages with an actual body are unaffected.
fix_summary: Removed the 'if !next.IsDone()' guard when advancing posMainContent past a parsed front-matter block, so the main-content offset is always recorded even when the block is the last thing in the file; RawContent() then correctly returns the (empty) slice after the front matter. The regression commit rewrote the page test to cover a front-matter-only page via a textar fixture.
notes: Commit subject references PR #11407, body 'Fixes #11406'. Era: Aug 2023 (hugo 0.119.x) but verified building the Aug-2023 tree with Go 1.27.1 (works; module system and go.sum are compatible across those eras, all deps still resolvable via proxy.golang.org). No build tags / external binaries needed; the test is a self-contained textar fixture (content/empty.md + single.html layout). Test run time after first compile: fractions of a second; first full compile of ./hugolib on 64 cores ~1-2 min, expect tens of minutes at 1 CPU, incremental afterwards.

issue_paraphrase: Partials that return a value (using the return statement) can no longer be called with a falsy argument: calling such a partial with an empty dictionary, an empty slice, an empty string, 0 or false aborts the whole site build with an error saying the partial needs a non-zero argument. The partial body is never evaluated, so its return value is lost. Partials called with truthy arguments (a non-empty dict, a number, a string) work fine.
fix_summary: Removed the 'needs a non-zero argument' rejection in tpl/partials/partials.go and changed the predefined partial-return wrapper template from a 'with .Arg' action to a 'range (slice .Arg)' action so the wrapper body executes even when the argument is falsy; updated the wrapping transformer to rewrite the range node instead of the with node. This is the fix for upstream issue #7528, merged as PR #9298.
notes: Era: Dec 2021 (hugo 0.91.x); verified with Go 1.27.1 which builds this 2021 tree fine. MUST use the -run filter: running the whole ./hugolib package on this 2021 tree also fails unrelated environment-dependent tests (TestImageOps: image-resize output differs from the 2021-era expectation under the current Go image library; TestPageWithDelimiter, TestPageWithShortCodeInSummary and friends: need rst2html/docutils installed; TestWordCountWithIsCJKLanguageFalse: CJK word-count behaves differently on this toolchain).
